text: It is Sunday evening, and Aziz sits at his laptop.

text: He opens the marketplace web profile to see where his new kettle is.
prefix: He opens the marketplace web profile to see where his new kettle is.

text: He types his phone number, then his password, and the password is right.
prefix: He types his phone number, then his password, and the password is right.

text: But the page does not open his order.
prefix: But the page does not open his order.

text: It asks him to approve the login in the mobile bank.
prefix: It asks him to approve the login in the mobile bank.

text: The password is right, so why is it not enough?
prefix: The password is right, so why is it not enough?

text: In Lesson 2, Aziz became one person, with one phone number, one password, and one session on each device.
prefix: In Lesson 2, Aziz became one person, with one phone number, one password, and one session on each device.

text: This lesson gives the three words that identity work uses for this moment, and it explains what a level really is.
prefix: This lesson gives the three words that identity work uses for this moment, and it explains what a level really is.

text: Each word answers a different question.
prefix: Each word answers a different question.

text: The first word is authentication.
prefix: The first word is authentication.

text: Authentication asks: is this the owner of the account?
prefix: Authentication asks: is this the owner of the account?

text: Aziz answers with something he knows, the password, and something he has, his phone.
prefix: Aziz answers with something he knows, the password, and something he has, his phone.

text: On his phone, the mobile bank shows the request, with Approve and This was not me.
prefix: On his phone, the mobile bank shows the request, with Approve and This was not me.

text: In other cases, the phone gets a one-time code instead.
prefix: In other cases, the phone gets a one-time code instead.

text: Notice what authentication does not say.
prefix: Notice what authentication does not say.

text: It does not say that this is Aziz from the state records.
prefix: It does not say that this is Aziz from the state records.

text: It says only that this is the person who registered the account.
prefix: It says only that this is the person who registered the account.

text: A stranger can register with their own phone and their own password, and pass authentication perfectly every day.
prefix: A stranger can register with their own phone and their own password, and pass authentication perfectly every day.

text: The second word is identity proofing.
prefix: The second word is identity proofing.

text: Identity proofing asks: is this the real person in the state records?
prefix: Identity proofing asks: is this the real person in the state records?

text: heeyID does it in one way only: MyID, in the master app.
prefix: heeyID does it in one way only: MyID, in the master app.

text: MyID compares a live face and a document with the state records.
prefix: MyID compares a live face and a document with the state records.

text: Aziz did it one time, in the mobile bank, last week.
prefix: Aziz did it one time, in the mobile bank, last week.

text: Proofing is slow and rare.
prefix: Proofing is slow and rare.

text: Authentication is fast, and it happens at every login.
prefix: Authentication is fast, and it happens at every login.

text: I think the most common mistake in identity work is to treat a strong login as proof of a person.
prefix: I think the most common mistake in identity work is to treat a strong login as proof of a person.

text: It is not.
prefix: It is not.

text: A password and a code prove that you hold the account, not who you are.
prefix: A password and a code prove that you hold the account, not who you are.

text: The third word is authorisation.
prefix: The third word is authorisation.

text: Authorisation asks: what may this session do, now?
prefix: Authorisation asks: what may this session do, now?

text: The marketplace must see level two before it shows personal data, like orders, addresses or cards.
prefix: The marketplace must see level two before it shows personal data, like orders, addresses or cards.

text: That is the rule that stopped the page.
prefix: That is the rule that stopped the page.

text: So what is a level?
prefix: So what is a level?

text: heeyID has three.
prefix: heeyID has three.

text: Level zero: nothing is verified.
prefix: Level zero: nothing is verified.

text: Level one: a one-time code verified the phone number.
prefix: Level one: a one-time code verified the phone number.

text: Level two: MyID proved the person against the state records, and the phone number is confirmed.
prefix: Level two: MyID proved the person against the state records, and the phone number is confirmed.

text: Only the check for a level gives that level.
prefix: Only the check for a level gives that level.

text: No operator and no setting can put a person at level two without MyID.
prefix: No operator and no setting can put a person at level two without MyID.

text: Now the part that surprises most developers.
prefix: Now the part that surprises most developers.

text: A person has a level, and a session has a level too.
prefix: A person has a level, and a session has a level too.

text: Aziz, the person, is at level two.
prefix: Aziz, the person, is at level two.

text: But a session gets level two only on a trusted device of a person at level two.
prefix: But a session gets level two only on a trusted device of a person at level two.

text: A trusted device is a phone where the person passed MyID.
prefix: A trusted device is a phone where the person passed MyID.

text: His phone is one.
prefix: His phone is one.

text: A browser is never one.
prefix: A browser is never one.

text: So the laptop session can reach level two in one way only: Aziz approves it in the master app, on his trusted phone.
prefix: So the laptop session can reach level two in one way only: Aziz approves it in the master app, on his trusted phone.

text: Back to Sunday evening.
prefix: Back to Sunday evening.

text: The request on his phone shows the browser, the network address and the time.
prefix: The request on his phone shows the browser, the network address and the time.

text: Aziz taps Approve.
prefix: Aziz taps Approve.

text: The laptop session gets level two, and the order page opens.
prefix: The laptop session gets level two, and the order page opens.

text: Now take a different evening.
prefix: Now take a different evening.

text: Aziz has no session in the mobile bank, so nobody can approve.
prefix: Aziz has no session in the mobile bank, so nobody can approve.

text: After the password, the bank's SMS service sends him a code, and he types it.
prefix: After the password, the bank's SMS service sends him a code, and he types it.

prefix: He is in: authentication passed.

text: But the laptop session is at level one, and the order stays closed.
prefix: But the laptop session is at level one, and the order stays closed.

text: The marketplace does not refuse him.
prefix: The marketplace does not refuse him.

text: It asks for a step-up: it names the level it needs, and the check that gives it.
prefix: It asks for a step-up: it names the level it needs, and the check that gives it.

text: Same person, same password, two different answers.
prefix: Same person, same password, two different answers.

text: The difference is the session, not the person.
prefix: The difference is the session, not the person.

text: Two more names, and you can read any identity document.
prefix: Two more names, and you can read any identity document.

text: OAuth 2.1 is the open standard for authorisation: how an app gets a token, and what the token lets it do.
prefix: OAuth 2.1 is the open standard for authorisation: how an app gets a token, and what the token lets it do.

text: OpenID Connect sits on top of it, and adds authentication: who logged in, and how.
prefix: OpenID Connect sits on top of it, and adds authentication: who logged in, and how.

text: heeyID has no token format of its own.
prefix: heeyID has no token format of its own.

text: Keycloak issues standard tokens, and each token carries the level of its session.
prefix: Keycloak issues standard tokens, and each token carries the level of its session.

text: So the marketplace reads the level from the token, and decides.
prefix: So the marketplace reads the level from the token, and decides.

text: To recap: authentication asks if this is the owner.
prefix: To recap: authentication asks if this is the owner.

text: Identity proofing asks if this is the real person.
prefix: Identity proofing asks if this is the real person.

text: Authorisation asks what the session may do.
prefix: Authorisation asks what the session may do.

text: A person has a level, and each session has its own.
prefix: A person has a level, and each session has its own.

text: So why did the right password not open the order?
prefix: So why did the right password not open the order?

text: Because a password answers only the first question.
